description: Soft-delete a file by id. Moves to a 30-day trash window before the cleanup cron hard-deletes + refunds the storage quota. Restorable via the REST PATCH endpoint (`PATCH /api/workspaces/{slug}/files/{id} body: {restore:true}`); a PATCH-equivalent MCP tool ships in Phase 6. Editor role required. Gated behind FILES_SURFACE_ENABLED + per-user allowlist.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts either the bare slug or the org-prefixed form ('my-org/my-workspace') as shown in the dashboard URL.

name: delete_file
